narration: In month {fork_month}, you chose {real_choice} and the ghost took {ghost_choice}. {first_bar_apart} parted first, in month {first_bar_apart_month}, the same month the ghost's money reached its lowest after the split. In month {substitution_month}, you chose {withdrawn_choice}, which was not available on this path, and the ghost took {substitute_choice}. The ghost moved ahead in month {crossover_month} and stayed there for {ghost_ahead_months} months. The layoff came in month {layoff_month}, and the ghost held {layoff_net_worth_gap}. In month {end_month}, the ghost finished with {net_worth_gap}.
